name: Karaoke Memorial
source:
Main heroine is a college student invited to karaoke. There are a lot of nice men in the karaoke box. Depending on her actions she can get into more serious relations than just flirt.  

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主人公是一名受邀去唱卡拉OK的大学生。包厢里有许多优秀的男子。根据她采取的行动，她可能会发展出比调情更认真的关系。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
